data.narrative:
Tytan Technologies is a Series A-stage Defense & Security company founded by Balazs Nagy and Batuhan Yumurtaci that has raised €30M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—operating in the same sector and stage, including Stark Defence, Singularity, NODA AI, Anduril Industries, and Helsing.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the €30M raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A progression, yielding €60M. Peer-median analysis examines three same-stage, same-sector comparables with valuations ranging from €125M (NODA AI) to €4.0B (Stark Defence), producing a median of €400M. The wide peer range reflects heterogeneity in business model maturity and capital intensity within defense technology.

Triangulating these methods produces a valuation range of €51M (low) to €460M (high), with a median of €230M. The stage-progression method anchors the lower bound, while peer comparables establish the ceiling. Key uncertainties include the degree to which Tytan's proprietary technology, customer traction, and go-to-market trajectory align with the outlier valuations in the peer set, particularly the €4.0B valuation observed in Stark Defence, which may reflect atypical market conditions or differentiated IP positioning.
